'''Tarast Voon''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] male who traveled to [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]] to rescue his former mentor, [[Hethan Romund]].

==Biography==
At some point in his youth, Voon discovered he was [[Force-sensitive]]. He was deeply excited by this and asked if it meant he could join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, despite his [[Youngling/Legends|young age]], he was deemed to old to begin the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], much to his dismay.<ref name="MR" /> 

Shortly afterwards, the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] occured along with the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result Voon was forced into hiding, as he was too young to fight back against the newly&ndash;formed Empire. His family, and later a evergrowing network of contacts, shuffled Voon from [[planet]] to planet, keeping him hidden from the Empire. On each planet he was taught details about their way of life, Voon, ever curious, enjoyed this immensely. However, he constantly longed for the stability and consistency that he could seemingly never have. As a way of coping with this he began to fixate on whatever challenges he could.<ref name="MR" /> 

Voon spent fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on the run, dreaming of a becoming a [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]], though forced into the life of a renegade. He studied all he could of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], eventually finding an ally in fellow scholar [[Hethan Romund]]. The two spent three years exploring ancient ruins and far&ndash;out libraries. With Romund eventually assisting Voon in the construction of his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="MR" />

After an unfortunate close call with an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] agent, the two parted ways, with Voon convinced that his very presence was putting his friend in danger, something he was unwilling to risk.<ref name="MR" />

A [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] reached Voon, in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], that his old friend Romund had been captured by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]] [[Malefax]] and taken to a lost temple on [[Mount Tellec]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. In order to save her, he joined forces with a band of other Force&ndash;sensitive allies Romund had made over the years.<ref name="MR" />
